</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Abilities</nowiki></u>
</div><div style="white-space:pre-line;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Conjure_Undead_Army <nowiki>Conjure Undead Army</nowiki>] <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="conjurearmy">[[File:Conjure Undead Army.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1166094935066423348.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>conjurearmy</nowiki>|<nowiki>conjurearmy</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>
    • Ensure </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="conjureghost">[[File:Conjure Vengeful Ghost.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809206423060632.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>conjureghost</nowiki>|<nowiki>conjureghost</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="conjureskeleton">[[File:Conjure Skeleton Warrior.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434516658651147.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>conjureskeleton</nowiki>|<nowiki>conjureskeleton</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="conjurezombie">[[File:Conjure Putrid Zombie.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809200219684924.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>conjurezombie</nowiki>|<nowiki>conjurezombie</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> are selected

⬥ This method does not require </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Soul_Split <nowiki>Soul Split</nowiki>] <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="soulsplit">[[File:Soul Split.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>soulsplit</nowiki>|<nowiki>soulsplit</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>
